title: 2128. Finding the Largest Element in an Array

Finding the Largest Element in an Array
30
Easy
Problem Statement
Read N integers into an array and print the largest element, using array traversal combined with an if statement.
Description
Read an integer N, then read N integers into a one-dimensional array. Assume the first element is the largest, then use a loop to compare every other element against it, updating the largest value whenever a bigger element is found using an if statement. Print the final largest value.
Input Description
An integer N, followed by N integers separated by spaces.
Output Description
Print the largest element of the array.
Sample Input
5 3 8 2 9 4
Sample Output
9
